projects.title: Hard to forget
projects.description:
Heavy Hit – Burger-i për të cilin të kanë folur! 

A ke gjetur ndonjëherë një burger aq të mirë sa i ke shkruar shpirtit binjak, miqve, të gjithëve: “Hej, kam gjetur një burger-in më të mirë në Prishtinë?”.
Nëse ende s’e ke bërë, mjafton të shkosh te Heavy Hit në Albi Mall dhe atje do të gjesh logon e një krokodili që po ha me pasion një burger.

data.content: Have you ever found a burger so good that you told your soulmate, your friends, everyone: “Hey, I’ve found the best burger in Prishtina”? If not yet, just head to Heavy Hit in Albi Mall, where you’ll find the logo of a crocodile passionately eating a burger.

When you see this logo, you’ll think of us, Karrota’s rabbits! Heavy Hit is undoubtedly a campaign we approached with lots of creativity and enthusiasm, not just because we love eating burgers, but also because it’s a fun and daring client.

Our concept for this brand is based on the taste that takes you on new paths and adventures, ending your hunger and starting a fantastic new experience! Quality ingredients, authentic flavor, and visual identity come together to make Heavy Hit a cool brand that sticks in the audience’s mind.

Inspired by these approaches, we created a logo that dares and breaks the rules, leaving a mark! Heavy Hit’s logo isn’t just a visual; it’s a statement! A crocodile getting ready to bite the best burger it’s ever tasted, showing hunger and confidence in its choice.
The logo uses bold, precise typography with clean cuts to convey the idea that Heavy Hit, just like its visual identity, is here to change the game!
So, the next time you go to Heavy Hit and take a bite of a burger, remember Karrota!
